notes: DOC-TIER: the framework would not install in this environment within the harness effort cap, and its architecture makes a lightweight harness integration impossible. Concrete evidence: (1) Architecture — OpenClaw is a multi-channel gateway/daemon product, not an embeddable agent-loop library: package.json description 'Multi-channel AI gateway with extensible messaging integrations'; the only headless one-shot path is `openclaw agent exec` (docs/cli/agent.md: 'runs one embedded agent turn without connecting to a Gateway... recommended headless entry point for CI'), which requires the full source build (openclaw.mjs -> dist/) at the pinned commit — there is no published-artifact shortcut faithful to the pin. (2) Tool integration surface exists but is build-gated: harness tools require a tool plugin via the plugin SDK (docs/plugins/sdk-entrypoints/define-tool-plugin.md, defineToolPlugin from 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/tool-plugin'); a complete plugin was authored (p1/harness/openclaw-plugin/ + openclaw-shim-bridge.py delegating to the frozen shims.py, restrictive tools.allow config, custom OpenAI-compatible provider registration per docs/gateway/config-tools/custom-providers.md) but it can only be exercised through the built CLI. (3) Install failure in this environment: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (pnpm 12.5.1 per packageManager field; Node v24.20.0 present) crawls through the egress-throttled npm registry — log /tmp/openclaw-install.log shows 'Request took 30392-51411ms' for registry metadata and 'Tarball download average speed 5-45 KiB/s'; the first full install died mid-linking after 'Progress: resolved 1473, reused 512, downloaded 432, added 928' with node_modules left unlinked; a filtered retry (`--filter openclaw... --prefer-offline`) sat in resolution >10 minutes at ~1% CPU (network-bound stall) and was stopped. The pinned tree is 902 MB with a Rust crates/ workspace alongside the TypeScript monorepo, so the subsequent `pnpm build` would be a second long grind. (4) Record shape if it had run: session state is SQLite-backed in this version (src/config/sessions/session-sqlite-target-paths.ts, src/state/agent-database-admission.ts), retained via agent exec --state-dir, not a plain per-run transcript file. Clone verified at the exact pinned SHA before the install attempts. Re-attempt condition: an environment with unthrottled registry access (or a pre-populated pnpm store + dist build) would make the prepared plugin/runner path (p1/harness/run_openclaw.py) directly usable.
